headline: DISTRICT ATTORNEY STRONGLY SUPPORTS FLOCK AUTOMATED LICENSE PLATE READER (ALPR) SYSTEMS IN MONTEREY COUNTY
summary: Monterey County District Attorney Jeannine M. Pacioni strongly urges the Board's continued support for FLOCK and other Automated License Plate Reader (ALPR) systems currently deployed by law enforcement agencies throughout Monterey…
